test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is: **Buisness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The correct spelling should be '**Business**'.
 
• **Business **means an organization or enterprising entity engaged in commercial, industrial, or professional activities.
 
 
• Example - *He has the skills necessary to run a **business**.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 3 which is incorrectly spelt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Fasten **means to fix or tie something to something, or two things together.
 
• **Plunge **means to push something suddenly and with force into something.
 
• **Evolve **means to come forth gradually into being; develop.
